summary: This document sets which cryptographic algorithms IPsec implementations must, should, or should not support for ESP and AH, the protocols that encrypt and authenticate IP traffic. It also adds guidance on choosing among them. It was replaced by RFC 8221.

eli5.summary: Two friends need a secret code to pass notes. This RFC lists which codes every notebook must know, which are nice to have, and which are too weak. It has since been replaced by a newer list.

questions: which algorithms must ipsec esp support
